analyzed_vuln.description: ReflectionEnumBackedCase::getBackingValue() unconditionally treats ref->value as an enum object and calls zend_enum_fetch_case_value(Z_OBJ(ref->value)). For malformed enum case values (PoC uses invalid backed value byte \xff), constant resolution can leave ref->value not matching the expected enum case object layout, but the code still reads OBJ_PROP_NUM(...,1). This causes an out-of-bounds read in zend_enum_fetch_case_value() (php-src/Zend/zend_enum.h:55-60). Root cause is missing type/layout validation in getBackingValue() before fetching enum backing property.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Data flow: fuzzer executes PHP script defining a backed enum with invalid case value and then calls (new ReflectionEnumBackedCase(Inm::class,'Foo'))->getBackingValue(). __construct only checks that the enum class is backed, not that the stored case value is a valid enum case object/value state. getBackingValue() updates constants and then blindly dereferences Z_OBJ(ref->value) as enum case storage. With malformed enum definition input, this leads to heap OOB read when accessing property slot 1.
